verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Deel can create contractor contracts via API and list contracts, but nothing documents sending offer letters or HR documents for e-signature, or storing documents per employee. Contract creation is an adjacent capability, not the e-signature and per-employee document storage this story asks for. The axis clearly applies to an HR and hiring platform, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee
